findings.evidence:
- Schema change: `pkg/session/bootstrap.go:3089` adds bootstrap ver212; `pkg/session/bootstrap.go:3093`/`pkg/session/bootstrap.go:3094` run `ALTER TABLE mysql.tidb_runaway_watch(_done) ADD COLUMN switch_group_name ...`.
- Upgrade runs automatically when `ver < currentBootstrapVersion`: `pkg/session/bootstrap.go:1401`.
- Old TiDB binaries insert without column lists: parent blob shows `INSERT ... VALUES` with fewer values (watch: `c9baef45d40c1765203953ecb76c58f394c7b707^:pkg/resourcegroup/runaway/record.go:112`; done: `c9baef45d40c1765203953ecb76c58f394c7b707^:pkg/resourcegroup/runaway/record.go:132`). New code still uses `INSERT ... VALUES` (watch: `pkg/resourcegroup/runaway/record.go:122`/`pkg/resourcegroup/runaway/record.go:133`; done: `pkg/resourcegroup/runaway/record.go:154`).
findings.fix: Make this rolling-upgrade safe via a 2-phase migration: (1) first release changes all writes to `mysql.tidb_runaway_watch(_done)` to use explicit column lists (and reads to avoid `SELECT *`), (2) only in a later bootstrap version add `switch_group_name`. If schema must change now, consider new v2 tables + dual-read/dual-write until old TiDBs are gone, or gate the `ALTER TABLE` until all TiDB nodes are upgraded.
findings.impact: Rolling upgrade hazard: once any new TiDB upgrades the system tables, older TiDB servers still running will hit `column count doesn't match value count` on inserts into `mysql.tidb_runaway_watch` / `mysql.tidb_runaway_watch_done` (e.g., `ADD QUERY WATCH`, quarantine persistence/cleanup), leading to errors, inconsistent watch propagation, and degraded runaway/resource-control behavior.
findings.later_fix_evidence: Not fixed on upstream/master: `upstream/master:pkg/session/upgrade_def.go:1852`/`upstream/master:pkg/session/upgrade_def.go:1853` still add `switch_group_name`, and `upstream/master:pkg/resourcegroup/runaway/record.go:133` still uses `INSERT ... VALUES` without column lists.
findings.verify: Simulate rolling upgrade: run an older TiDB and a newer TiDB concurrently; let the newer one perform the ver212 upgrade; then from the older TiDB trigger `AddRunawayWatch` paths (e.g., `ADD QUERY WATCH`, or a quarantining event) and confirm no insert errors and watch persistence/cleanup still works.
findings.what: Bootstrap schema upgrade adds `switch_group_name` to runaway watch system tables, but inserts rely on `INSERT ... VALUES` without column lists; during rolling upgrades, older TiDB binaries will start failing inserts after any newer node upgrades the tables.

findings.evidence:
- `SHOW CREATE RESOURCE GROUP` uses `ResourceGroupSettings.String()`: `pkg/executor/show.go:1613`.
- String formatting emits unquoted `ACTION=SWITCH_GROUP(%s)`: `pkg/meta/model/resource_group.go:88`/`pkg/meta/model/resource_group.go:89`.
- Parser restore treats the group name as an identifier needing `WriteName` quoting: `pkg/parser/ast/ddl.go:2358`/`pkg/parser/ast/ddl.go:2360`, and restore tests expect `SWITCH_GROUP(`rg2`)`: `pkg/parser/ast/ddl_test.go:956`/`pkg/parser/ast/ddl_test.go:957`.
findings.fix: Quote/escape `SwitchGroupName` as a SQL identifier when formatting (e.g., backtick-escape, or reuse AST restore/formatting helpers) in `pkg/meta/model/resource_group.go` and any other display paths (e.g., `pkg/executor/infoschema_reader.go`).
findings.impact: `SHOW CREATE RESOURCE GROUP` (and display strings like `information_schema.resource_groups.QUERY_LIMIT`) can become invalid/unreplayable SQL when the switch target group name requires quoting/escaping, breaking tooling and user workflows that rely on `SHOW CREATE` output.
findings.later_fix_evidence: Not fixed on upstream/master: `upstream/master:pkg/meta/model/resource_group.go:127`/`upstream/master:pkg/meta/model/resource_group.go:128` still formats `ACTION=%s(%s)` without identifier quoting.
findings.verify: Create a resource group whose name requires quoting (e.g., contains `-` or is a reserved word), set runaway action `SWITCH_GROUP(<that name>)`, then ensure `SHOW CREATE RESOURCE GROUP` outputs valid SQL that can be executed to recreate the same settings.
findings.what: `SHOW CREATE RESOURCE GROUP` builds `ACTION=SWITCH_GROUP(<name>)` without quoting/escaping `<name>`, so the emitted SQL may be invalid for legal resource group identifiers and diverges from parser restore behavior.

subject: pkg/parser: support SWITCH_GROUP syntax for runaway watch (#54804)
summary: Commit adds runaway action `SWITCH_GROUP(name)` across parser/DDL/executor/runaway-manager, persists `switch_group_name` via bootstrap ver212 system-table upgrades, and updates infoschema/show formatting to display the new action.
